title: Compatibility reconciliation playbook for fallback model variants (tokenizer/context/tooling parity)
creator: Diego Morales
description:
Background: Recent incidents and rollout tests revealed intermittent failures when the smart router falls back between model variants with differing tokenizers, context handling, or inference tooling (quantized kernels, KV layout). This ticket creates an operational playbook and automation to reconcile the compatibility matrix for fallback variants, prevent regressions, and provide deterministic remediation paths.

Scope: inventory the deployed fallback candidates, codify tokenizer roundtrip and context/KV-cache parity checks, add CI + scheduled sweep jobs, wire console health indicators, and publish a runbook for on-call and release engineers. This work focuses on variant metadata, tooling compatibility flags, and automated metadata PRs to the model-catalog. It does not include full re-training or model provenance fixes but will produce flags and mitigation steps for owners.

Objectives: establish automated tests that detect tokenizer/context/tooling mismatches before they reach the routing layer; reduce fallback-induced errors by 80% for top 20 variants; provide a single source-of-truth compatibility matrix and an on-call remediation checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility matrix updated and published in the internal model-catalog with explicit tokenizer, max_context, kv_layout, and tooling flags for all fallback candidates
CI gating job added that fails PRs which change variant metadata without passing tokenizer/context parity tests
Automated sanity PR generator creates suggested metadata fixes for mismatches with human review enabled
Dashboard panels added to Console displaying mismatch rate per-region and per-tier and alerting when mismatch rate > 1% for 24h
Runbook published with step-by-step remediation, owner contact list, and postmortem template
tasks: Inventory: pull current fallback variant list from model-catalog and runtime routing tables (scope: top 50 by traffic)
Design tests: implement tokenizer roundtrip, token-id mapping checks, and context/KV layout parity tests
CI integration: add runner that executes parity tests on model metadata PRs and variant promotions
Auto-PR: implement bot to propose metadata corrections (e.g., tokenizer label, max_context) with links to failing test cases
Observability: add Console dashboard tiles and alert rules for mismatch and fallback error surfaces
Runbook: draft, review with SRE/Applied ML, publish to internal docs and link from Console alerts
Rollout: pilot sweep for top 20 variants, iterate on false positives, extend to top 50
